meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描项目找出未被引用的代码,用 LSP 查引用确认为死代码,再分给多个并行 agent 删除;每个 agent 改完必须通过类型检查才提交一次原子 commit,最后给出删除清单汇总。
howto.when: 当你说出 “remove dead code”、“cleanup” 等关键词,或要求对某个文件、目录、符号做死代码清理时触发;参数为空或 “all” 则全项目扫描。

say.text: 清理 src/foo.ts 里的死代码
say.note: 只处理该文件,类型检查通过后提交原子 commit

say.text: 清扫 src/utils 目录下未使用的符号
say.note: 只扫描该目录,逐个用 LSP 确认引用为零

say.text: 全项目扫描并移除 dead code
say.note: 候选超过 50 个会先停下来问你

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project for unused code, confirms candidates via LSP references, then delegates removals to parallel agents that commit only after typecheck passes, and reports a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "remove dead code", "cleanup" and similar, or ask to clean dead code in a given file, directory or symbol; empty or "all" scans the whole project.

say_en.text: Clean up dead code in src/foo.ts
say_en.note: Only that file; commits once typecheck passes.
Scans that directory, verifies zero references via LSP.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project and remove dead code
say_en.note: Stops to ask if over 50 candidates are found.
